# SIHINA 2026 – Team Rad KDU (Sihina KDU)

> SIHINA is the Annual Radiography Day Celebration Project of the Society of Radiography and Radiotherapy, Faculty of Allied Health Sciences (FAHS), General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University (KDU), Sri Lanka. SIHINA 2026 ("For a hopeful tomorrow"), led by Intake 40, is renovating an old classroom complex at Urugala Sri Dharmaloka School, Ingiriya, Horana.

Website: https://team-rad-kdu.github.io/Sihina/

Also known as: Sihina, Sihina KDU, KDU Sihina, KDU Project Sihina, Sihina 2026, Shina 2026, සිහින, Team Rad, Team Rad KDU, Team Rad KDU Sihina.
"Sihina" (සිහින) means "dreams" in Sinhala.

## Key facts
- Organizer: Team Rad KDU – Society of Radiography and Radiotherapy, Intake 40, FAHS, KDU
- Beneficiary: Urugala Sri Dharmaloka School, Ingiriya, Horana, Sri Lanka (39.6 km from FAHS, KDU)
- Reach: about 400 students; about 110 direct beneficiaries
- Proposed budget: Rs. 762,830 (line-by-line budget on the website)
- Planned work: painting (floor paint, weather shield, filler, skim coat, lacquer), electrical wiring, switches and plug bases, three ceiling fans, three 8×4 green boards, floor and building repairs, classroom furniture and colour-washing, a GCE O/L seminar
- World Radiography Day: 8 November

## Timeline (2026)
- 28 Jul – 07 Aug: project proposal approval
- 20 Aug – 15 Sep: fund collection
- 16 – 18 Sep: allocation of funds
- 19 Sep: project begins
- 20 Sep – 20 Oct: renovation and construction
- Then: completion and handover ceremony

## Past SIHINA projects
- 2024 (Intake 38): Illukovita Primary School – renovated a three-classroom building, donated 120+ stationery packs
- 2022/23 (Intake 37): Rehabilitation Home for Differently Abled, Ambanpitiya, Kegalle – classroom renovation, painting, wiring, wheelchairs, hospital bed and essentials for about 40 residents
- 2021 (Intake 36): Mahindagama Village, Polonnaruwa – RO water filtration system for 80+ families
- 2019 (Intake 35): Hanguranketha Gangapalatha MMV – classroom complex donation
- 2018 (Intake 34): Mahawila Kanishta Vidyalaya, Mahawila – rebuilt the library and provided IT facilities (held 24 February 2019)
- 2017 (Intake 33): Prince College, Maduragama, Nikaweratiya – library repaired and refurnished
- 2016 (Intake 32): Sri Sumangala Maha Vidyalaya, Medirigiriya – water filtration system, sports equipment, library books
- 2015 (Intake 31): Getamanna South Maha Vidyalaya, Hambantota – computer lab repair, library refurbishment
- 2014 (Intake 30): Hakahinna Maha Vidyalaya – water supply, library extension, GCE O/L seminar
